exp.desc:
- Three school extensions up to £12m
- Programme and cost control, change management

cl.p1: three school extensions in five years, the largest worth twelve million pounds: all of them were handed over before the start of term, one after two weekends of extra shifts that the site manager and I still joke about.
cl.p2: I would now like to move to the client side. I know what contractors struggle with and what information they need, and when. Tendering, change control and programme management are my daily work. I am a chartered civil engineer and live locally.

letters.label: Construction project lead moving to the client side

cl.p1: commissioning jobs abroad have been my work for eight years. I have seen which projects go well and which do not, and it is rarely the engineering. It is planning, coordination and expectations, and that is where I want to work now.
cl.p2: As a field engineer I have coordinated teams of up to six on sites in Poland, Mexico and India, written daily reports, agreed changes with clients and worked through snag lists. Last year I gained a project management qualification part time.
cl.p3: Travel does not put me off, as long as it is no longer 200 days a year.

letters.label: Field engineer moving into project management
